description: Departure (or arrival) board for a station or stop: time, live delay, train/bus line, platform, destination and main stops. Optionally only services going towards a given place.

date.description: Date: "YYYY-MM-DD", "today", "tomorrow", a weekday ("friday", "piątek") or "DD.MM". Default: today.

direction.description: Only services that later call at this place, e.g. 'Poznań'.

modes.description: Restrict to these modes, e.g. ["train"] or ["train","bus"]. Default: all loaded.

station.description: Station or stop name, e.g. 'Kraków Główny', 'Zbąszyń'

time.description: Local time "HH:MM" (Europe/Warsaw). Default: now (today) or 04:00 (other days).

name: departures
title: Station departures / arrivals board
